summary: This Form 6-K is a routine filing by Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, a foreign private issuer, furnishing certifications under Rule 13a-14 and Section 906 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act in connection with its quarterly report for the period ended July 31, 2026. It contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or management change; it is purely a regulatory compliance filing by the issuer.
